```{r}
#| label: setup-and-stats
library(terra)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
library(jsonlite)

here::i_am("outputs/efg-membership-rasters/README.qmd")
out_dir <- here::here("outputs", "efg-membership-rasters")

zenodo_meta <- fromJSON(file.path(out_dir, ".zenodo.json"))
summary_tbl <- read_csv(
    file.path(out_dir, "TASVEG-xref-EFG-membership-summary.csv"),
    show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Inspect first GeoTIFF for shared grid specifications
sample_rast <- rast(file.path(out_dir, summary_tbl$file_name[1]))
crs_info <- crs(sample_rast, describe = TRUE)
crs_label <- sprintf("%s (%s:%s)", crs_info$name[1], crs_info$authority[1], crs_info$code[1])
res_xy <- res(sample_rast)
pixel_km2 <- prod(res_xy) / 1e6
pixel_ha <- prod(res_xy) / 1e4
n_rows <- nrow(sample_rast)
n_cols <- ncol(sample_rast)
n_bands <- nlyr(sample_rast)
total_cells <- ncell(sample_rast)
ext_bbox <- as.vector(ext(sample_rast))

n_efgs <- nrow(summary_tbl)
n_best_efgs <- sum(summary_tbl$n_best_units > 0)
n_nonbest_efgs <- sum(summary_tbl$n_best_units == 0)
n_realms <- n_distinct(summary_tbl$realm_id)
n_biomes <- n_distinct(summary_tbl$biome_id)
round_nr <- summary_tbl$round[1]
n_interp <- max(summary_tbl$total_interp)
total_weighted_km2 <- sum(summary_tbl$weighted_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE)
```

## 1. Overview & Methodology

This dataset provides **`r n_efgs` spatial raster layers (`r res_xy[1]` m resolution GeoTIFFs)** representing the aggregated fuzzy membership (`prop_memb`) of Tasmania's statewide vegetation map (**TASVEG 5.0**) to each candidate Level 3 **Ecosystem Functional Group (EFG)** of the **IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology (IUCN GET)**.

### Why Per-EFG Membership Rasters?

When cross-referencing regional vegetation classifications (TASVEG 5.0) to global functional typologies (IUCN GET), individual mapping units (`VEGCODE`) frequently have partial or one-to-many relationships across multiple target EFGs (due to environmental gradients, broad mapping complex definitions, or expert uncertainty).

- Whereas a single **"best-candidate" ("winner-takes-all")** map retains only the single highest-scoring EFG per source unit (`r n_best_efgs` EFGs in Tasmania), this **per-EFG membership raster stack** retains **all `r n_efgs` candidate EFGs** assigned any non-zero membership in Round `r round_nr` across the `r n_interp` interpreters—including **`r n_nonbest_efgs` additional EFGs** that represent secondary/partial ecosystem components within TASVEG mapping units.
- For each source `VEGCODE` $s$ and candidate target EFG $t$, the aggregated membership proportion is calculated across all `r n_interp` interpreters in Round `r round_nr` (`ecoSynthesis::summarise_membership(..., keep_all = TRUE, which_round = 2)`):
  $$\text{prop\_memb}_{s, t} = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^{`r n_interp`} m_{s, t, i}}{\sum_{k} \sum_{i=1}^{`r n_interp`} m_{s, k, i}}$$
- For each EFG $t$, polygons in `TASVEG_5_0.shp` with $\text{prop\_memb}_{s, t} > 0$ are rasterized at **`r res_xy[1]` m × `r res_xy[2]` m** resolution using `fasterize::fasterize(..., field = "prop_memb", fun = "sum")`. Pixels outside polygons assigned to EFG $t$ (as well as the three non-eligible natural units `OAQ`, `ORO`, and `OSM`) are encoded as `NoData` (`NA`).

## 2. File Inventory

| File Name | Format | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TASVEG-xref-{EFG}-memb-90m.tiff` (`r n_efgs` files) | GeoTIFF (`r datatype(sample_rast)` / float32) | **`r res_xy[1]` m membership raster for each candidate IUCN GET EFG** (`prop_memb` in $(0, 1]$, `NA` where membership is 0 or outside eligible polygons). |
| `TASVEG-xref-EFG-membership-summary.csv` | CSV (UTF-8, `r n_efgs` rows) | **Summary table for all `r n_efgs` EFG rasters**, including file names, IUCN GET hierarchy, Global Ecosystems Atlas pixel/color codes, contributing TASVEG unit counts, membership ranges, and unweighted/weighted areas ($\text{km}^2$). |
| `datapackage.json` | JSON (Frictionless Data) | **Machine-readable Frictionless Data Package specification** describing the CSV schema and GeoTIFF resources. |
| `.zenodo.json` | JSON | **Zenodo deposit metadata** (creators, contributors, grants, communities, license, keywords, and related DOIs/URLs). |
| `LICENSE` | Plain text / Markdown | **Full licensing terms** (CC BY 4.0 for data/docs, CC BY 3.0 AU attribution for TASVEG 5.0, MIT for code). |
| `README.md` / `README.qmd` | Markdown / Quarto | **Dataset documentation file** and the reproducible Quarto template that generates it. |

---

## 3. Spatial Specifications

All `r n_efgs` GeoTIFF files (`TASVEG-xref-{EFG}-memb-90m.tiff`) share an identical spatial grid:

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| **Coordinate Reference System (CRS)** | ``r crs_label`` |
| **Spatial Resolution** | ``r sprintf("%g m × %g m", res_xy[1], res_xy[2])`` (``r sprintf("%.4f km²", pixel_km2)`` / ``r sprintf("%.2f ha", pixel_ha)`` per pixel) |
| **Grid Dimensions** | ``r sprintf("%d rows × %d columns × %d band", n_rows, n_cols, n_bands)`` (``r format(total_cells, big.mark = ",")`` total grid cells) |
| **Bounding Box (`xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax`)** | ``r sprintf("%.0f, %.0f, %.0f, %.0f", ext_bbox[1], ext_bbox[2], ext_bbox[3], ext_bbox[4])`` (meters, `r paste0(crs_info$authority[1], ":", crs_info$code[1])`) |
| **Pixel Values (`prop_memb`)** | Continuous floating-point values in $(0, 1]$ where EFG membership $>0$; `NA` (`NoData`) elsewhere |
| **Total Weighted Area Across All `r n_efgs` Layers** | ``r sprintf("%s km²", format(round(total_weighted_km2, 2), big.mark = ",", nsmall = 2))`` ($\sum_{t=1}^{`r n_efgs`} \sum_{\text{pixels}} \text{prop\_memb}_{t} \times 0.0081\text{ km}^2$) |
| **Embedded GDAL Metadata Tags** | `AREA_OR_POINT = Area`, `PROJECT`, `TITLE`, `DESCRIPTION`, `EFG_CODE`, `EFG_NAME` |

## 4. Summary of the `r n_efgs` EFG Membership Rasters

The table below summarises all **`r n_efgs` IUCN GET Level 3 Ecosystem Functional Groups** included in this dataset (also available in `TASVEG-xref-EFG-membership-summary.csv`):

```{r}
#| label: efg-summary-table
#| results: asis
tbl_display <- summary_tbl |>
    transmute(
        `File Name` = sprintf("`%s`", file_name),
        `EFG` = sprintf("**`%s`**", EFG),
        `Ecosystem Functional Group Name` = efg_name,
        `Realm` = sprintf("`%s`", realm_id),
        `TASVEG Units (n_tasveg_units)` = n_tasveg_units,
        `Best-Cand. Units (n_best_units)` = n_best_units,
        `prop_memb Range` = sprintf("%.2f–%.2f", min_prop_memb, max_prop_memb),
        `Max Support` = sprintf("%d/%d", max_supporting, total_interp),
        `Mapped Pixels (>0)` = format(mapped_pixels_90m, big.mark = ","),
        `Unweighted Area (km²)` = format(round(unweighted_area_km2, 2), big.mark = ",", nsmall = 2),
        `Weighted Area (km²)` = format(round(weighted_area_km2, 2), big.mark = ",", nsmall = 2)
    )

kable(
    tbl_display,
    format = "pipe",
    align = c("l", "l", "l", "c", "r", "r", "c", "c", "r", "r", "r")
)
```

## 5. Tabular Data Dictionary (`TASVEG-xref-EFG-membership-summary.csv`)

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `file_name` | `string` | GeoTIFF file name (`TASVEG-xref-{EFG}-memb-90m.tiff`). |
| `EFG` | `string` | IUCN GET Level 3 Ecosystem Functional Group code (primary key, e.g., `T2.5`, `TF1.7`). |
| `efg_name` | `string` | Full name of the Ecosystem Functional Group. |
| `efg_pixel_value` | `integer` | Standard integer pixel code in the Global Ecosystems Atlas (`geco` package). |
| `realm_id` / `realm_name` | `string` | IUCN GET Level 1 Realm code and name (`F`, `MFT`, `MT`, `T`, `TF`). |
| `biome_id` / `biome_name` | `string` | IUCN GET Level 2 Functional Biome code and name. |
| `efg_hex_code` / `efg_rgb_code` | `string` | Official hexadecimal (`#RRGGBB`) and RGB (`R,G,B`) colors from `geco`. |
| `round` | `integer` | Expert elicitation round (`r round_nr`). |
| `total_interp` | `integer` | Total number of interpreters in Round `r round_nr` (`r n_interp`). |
| `n_tasveg_units` | `integer` | Number of TASVEG 5.0 communities with $>0$ membership to this EFG. |
| `n_best_units` | `integer` | Number of TASVEG 5.0 communities where this EFG is the single highest-ranked ("best") candidate (`0` indicates a secondary/minor EFG). |
| `min_prop_memb` / `max_prop_memb` | `numeric` | Minimum and maximum non-zero `prop_memb` values across contributing TASVEG units. |
| `max_supporting` | `integer` | Maximum number of interpreters assigning $>0$ membership to this EFG across its contributing TASVEG units (`1` to ``r n_interp``). |
| `mapped_pixels_90m` | `integer` | Count of 90 m grid cells with `prop_memb > 0`. |
| `unweighted_area_km2` | `numeric` | Total unweighted area ($\text{km}^2$) of all 90 m cells where `prop_memb > 0`. |
| `sum_pixel_memb` | `numeric` | Sum of `prop_memb` across all 90 m grid cells in the raster. |
| `weighted_area_km2` | `numeric` | Membership-weighted area ($\text{km}^2$), equal to `sum_pixel_memb * 0.0081`. |

---

## 6. How to Use This Dataset

### In R (`terra`)

```r
library(terra)
library(readr)

# 1. Load summary table and stack all 31 EFG membership rasters
summary_tbl <- read_csv("TASVEG-xref-EFG-membership-summary.csv")
efg_stack   <- rast(summary_tbl$file_name)
names(efg_stack) <- summary_tbl$EFG

# 2. Plot membership for a single EFG (e.g. T2.5 Temperate pyric humid forests)
plot(efg_stack[["T2.5"]], main = "T2.5 Membership Proportion (90 m)")

# 3. Verify total membership per pixel or compute maximum membership across all EFGs
max_memb <- app(efg_stack, fun = "max", na.rm = TRUE)
```

### Reproducing the Outputs from Source

```bash
# 1. Run the per-EFG 90m membership raster script
R --vanilla < inc/EFG-membership-raster.R > reproducibility-notes/EFG-membership-raster-out.txt

# 2. Render README.md with updated statistics
quarto render outputs/efg-membership-rasters/README.qmd --to gfm
```
